name: Perfect Corp
tagline: Perfect Corp's YouCam technology scans a face to score things like wrinkles, redness, pores, and dark spots, then shows what different treatments or products would look like before a client commits to anything. Estheticians and spas use it to back up a treatment recommendation with a visual score instead of just a verbal opinion, and to generate the before-and-after comparisons that work well in marketing. The same engine also powers virtual makeup and skincare try-on widgets that beauty brands embed on their own sites.
